subject: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@novexa.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T15:02:00Z
Subject: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the pilot partnership. We're planning a short customer announcement to highlight the results and would love to include a quote from Novexa, your logo, and a one-pager we can share with press. High-level asks:

- Short customer quote (1–2 sentences) we can use in a press release and blog post.
- Final high-res logo (SVG preferred) and a brief description of the integration (1–2 lines).
- Any embargo timing preferences (we're proposing Wed Apr 27, 10:00 PT) or a restriction window.

If you can send over the quote and logo by EOD Monday (4/19) that would give our PR team time to draft the release and share with you for sign-off. I'm CC'ing Stephanie (PR), Monica (account lead), and Laura from legal for any asset/usage checks.

Sample prompt: “Working with Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency by 60% and cut per-call cost, letting us ship our feature two months earlier.” Feel free to edit.

Also, if Novexa needs any formal MPA or marketing permission signature, please point us to the right person (contracts@novexa.ai is fine).

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (proposed schedule stub)
From: Sara Gomez <sara@novexa.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@novexa.ai
Date: 2027-04-19T20:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement

Hi Marcus —

Thanks — excited to do this. Quick answers:

- Approved quote (please use): “Redwood's inference platform let us deliver a responsive AI feature with predictable cost and reliability far sooner than expected.”
- Logo: attaching brand pack (logo_master.svg and novexa-mark.png).
- Embargo: we prefer a coordinated go-live with our product page. A 24-hour window after our page is live would be ideal — if Redwood goes live April 27 at 10:00 PT, please hold off public outreach until April 28 at 10:00 PT.

Cc'd contracts so they see the asset request. If legal needs to redline anything, they'll respond separately.

Thanks for pulling this together.
Sara
Head of Marketing, Novexa

Attachment: novexa-logo.zip (contains logo_master.svg, novexa-mark.png)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement

Folks — forwarding Sara's note and logo pack. Key items for PR ops:

- Novexa approved a customer quote (full text above). Legal wants to confirm usage rights and embargo window (they prefer 24-hour hold after Novexa's page goes live).
- Novexa attached logos (SVG + PNG) — I'm attaching our working one-pager and a draft release for you to review.
- Proposed internal timeline: draft by Tue 4/20, share to Novexa for sign-off Wed 4/21, publish Wed 4/27 (Redwood), Novexa asked for 24-hour hold after their product page — need to confirm exact time.

Laura — can you confirm whether the quote text is acceptable as-is or if you want edits? Also please confirm whether the MPA/marketing permission email from contracts@novexa.ai is sufficient or if we need a countersigned doc.

Stephanie/Monica — prepping asset pack and draft PR. I'll ask for final sign-off from Novexa once legal is OK.

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachment: novexa-customer-onepager.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T14:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement

Marcus / team —

Quick legal read: overall fine but recommend a small tweak to the quote to avoid comparative superlatives. Suggest changing “predictable cost and reliability far sooner than expected” to “predictable cost and reliability, enabling us to ship more quickly.” That keeps the sense without an absolute claim.

On embargo/usage: contracts@novexa.ai granting permission in email is acceptable for logo/quote usage, but ask Novexa for a brief written confirmation of the embargo window and which channels are restricted (press release, social, blog). If they want a countersigned MPA addendum, we'll handle it, but not required for this simple use case.

I've attached the signed MPA we have on file for record. No heavy redlines needed.

—Laura
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: signed-mpa-novexa.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@novexa.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@pressly.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T16:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the logo files — appreciate it. Laura from our legal team suggested a very small wording tweak to avoid comparative language. Proposed quote (tweak in bold):

“Redwood's inference platform let us deliver a responsive AI feature with predictable cost and reliability, enabling us to ship more quickly.”

Would you be able to confirm that wording is OK? If so we'll slot it into the draft release and send the full asset pack for sign-off.

Separately — we had proposed to publish a Redwood blog + press release on Wed Apr 27 at 10:00 PT. You mentioned Novexa prefers a 24-hour hold after your product page is live. Is Novexa planning to publish your page on Apr 27 at 10:00 PT as well, or should we coordinate a different target? If Novexa publishes at 10:00 PT and requires 24 hours, our public outreach should wait until Apr 28 10:00 PT. Please confirm the exact publish time and allowed channels (i.e., blog, press, social).

Once you confirm the quote and embargo time we will deliver the final PR draft and asset pack (one-pager, quotes, logo files). Evan from Pressly is on CC in case Novexa wants media distribution help.

Best,
Marcus
From: Sara Gomez <sara@novexa.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@pressly.com>
Cc: contracts@novexa.ai
Date: 2027-04-22T18:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Novexa pilot: coordination for customer announcement

Marcus —

All good on our side. The revised sentence is fine — please use the wording you proposed. Novexa will publish our product page on Apr 27 at 09:00 PT, and we request a 24-hour embargo on public press and partner blog posts (so Redwood publish no earlier than Apr 28 at 09:00 PT). Social posts and industry newsletters are also included in the hold.

I've attached the final brand pack (logo_master.svg) and a short marketing approval note from contracts@novexa.ai confirming permission to use the quote and logo under the existing MPA.

Looking forward to the draft.

Best,
Sara
Head of Marketing, Novexa
